CVE-2023-1183.title: A flaw was found in the Libreoffice package. An attacker can craf ...
CVE-2023-1183.description: A flaw was found in the Libreoffice package. An attacker can craft an odb containing a "database/script" file with a SCRIPT command where the contents of the file could be written to a new file whose location was determined by the attacker.

CVE-2026-101353.title: LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB databas ...
CVE-2026-101353.description: LibreOffice Base documents can contain an embedded HSQLDB database, and other documents can use such a database as a data source. The definition of the database in a crafted document could make the database engine create or write files at locations outside the document, chosen by the document. In fixed versions the files of an embedded database are kept in a private location, and an embedded database cannot create table files anywhere else.

CVE-2026-104692.title: LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used ...
CVE-2026-104692.description: LibreOffice bundles the HSQLDB database engine, which can be used through the generic JDBC database driver as well as through the support for embedded databases. HSQLDB lets SQL statements call Java methods, limited to the classes that are permitted. When HSQLDB was used through the generic JDBC driver this limit did not apply, so SQL in a crafted document could call any Java method and run code. In fixed versions SQL can call only the built-in functions of HSQLDB, whichever way the database is reached.
